cleaner.label: Yarn
cleaner.description: Global caches of Yarn Classic and Yarn Berry. Does not touch projects or the .yarn\cache folder inside projects.

option.label: Yarn Classic cache
option.description: Removes the global package cache of Yarn 1.

option.label: Yarn Berry global cache
option.description: Removes the global package cache of Yarn 2 and later.
option.warning: Re-downloaded on the next `yarn install`. Plug'n'Play projects that use the global cache will not start until you run `yarn install` again.
